name: proofbundle
description: Local files, signed cryptographic receipts, encryption, and verifiable history.

scripts.test:crypto: (cd crypto && node t_keccak.mjs && node t_mlkem.mjs && node t_ref.mjs && node t_confidential.mjs && node t_vault_stream.mjs) && npm run test:native && npm run test:html-crypto
scripts.test:surface: node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs test/negative/*.test.mjs test/hostile/*.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-vectors.mjs && node scripts/check-registry.mjs && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run selftest && npm run test:crypto && npm run test:surface
scripts.test:native: node crypto/t_native_profile.mjs && node scripts/verify-rfc6979.mjs && node scripts/verify-nist-acvp.mjs
scripts.build:html: node scripts/embed-native-crypto.mjs && python3 scripts/connect-native-crypto.py && python3 scripts/embed-browser-workspace.py
